_comment: VIDEO generation (TikTok, adverts). This is a MOTION brief, not
a face description: the face comes from the still render, which
is why still.json is generated first. Re-describing the face in
text is exactly how identity drifts between clips.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

reference_image.source: appearance/still.json -> the approved headshot or classroom render for this tutor
reference_image.why: text alone produces a different person every run; the reference locks the face. Do not go the other way and pull a still out of a clip - video frames are soft, motion-blurred and compressed.

identity_lock: chalk dust on the right cuff
_identity_lock_note: if the model supports text guidance alongside the reference, restate ONLY these - they are what the audience recognises

performance.energy: contained authority - the room quiets without him raising his voice
performance.spoken_register: formal, low and warm, unhurried but brisk; no filler
performance.body: stands square and still, weight even, chin slightly lifted; gestures only to point at a step on the board
performance.expression: composed, attentive, the faint approval of a teacher watching a student get it right; smiles rarely and briefly

camera.framing: 9:16 vertical for TikTok - head and shoulders in the top two thirds, room for captions below
camera.continuity: same wardrobe, same accessories and same hairstyle across a campaign; regenerate from continuity_anchors rather than re-describing from scratch

audio.dialogue: supplied separately from this tutor's own scripts (greetings/, signoffs/, samples.json)
audio.note: lip-sync to supplied audio where the model supports it; never let the model invent speech for a tutor

shots.purpose: TikTok / advert hook, talking to camera
shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 talking-to-camera clip. A 52-58 year old Black South African male teacher, tall and lean, straight-backed, long hands, long oval face, high cheekbones, deep-set dark brown eyes, defined jaw, deep nasolabial lines from decades of speaking, warm deep-brown skin with even undertone. Hair: close-cropped hair receding at the temples, uniformly grey-white; neatly trimmed short beard, salt-heavy with a darker moustache. Wearing charcoal or navy three-piece suit worn without the jacket while teaching: crisp white shirt, buttoned waistcoat, dark tie held by a plain clip, sleeves precisely folded to mid-forearm. Energy: contained authority - the room quiets without him raising his voice. Delivery matches the voice: formal, low and warm, unhurried but brisk; no filler. stands square and still, weight even, chin slightly lifted; gestures only to point at a step on the board Background: ordered classroom, board filled with neatly aligned algebra in straight lines, desks in rows, late-afternoon light, softly out of focus. Head and shoulders in the upper two thirds, clear space below for captions. Natural handheld micro-movement, photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, catchlights in the eyes, shallow depth of field.

shots.purpose: background b-roll, not looking at camera
shots.prompt: The person from the reference image teaching in ordered classroom, board filled with neatly aligned algebra in straight lines, desks in rows, late-afternoon light. stands square and still, weight even, chin slightly lifted; gestures only to point at a step on the board Not looking at camera. Documentary feel, natural light, static camera or slow push-in, 8 seconds.

negative_prompt: face drifting from the reference image, changing age, changing skin tone, changing hairline, morphing wardrobe, warping hands, extra fingers, jittering eyes, lip-sync mismatch, whip pans, orbiting camera, speed ramps, slow motion, cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, American classroom props, chalkboard gibberish, unreadable equations, board crowded with writing, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, generic stock-photo smile
